# Sails Protocol Blog

> Editorial articles about open peer-to-peer economic coordination. This is not normative protocol documentation or a statement of production readiness.

- [Articles](https://sails-protocol-blog.netlify.app/articles/): Technical and editorial writing
- [Introduction](https://sails-protocol-blog.netlify.app/articles/what-is-sails-protocol/): Conceptual introduction
- [Protocol source of truth](https://github.com/sails-protocol/Sails-Protocol): Repository with implementation and technical decisions
- [Editorial policy](https://github.com/sails-protocol/Sails-Protocol-Blog/blob/feat/blog-foundation-02/EDITORIAL-POLICY.md): Publication rules

For claims about security, escrow, settlement, custody or readiness, verify the underlying implementation and CTO-approved evidence.
